nfc_supply_u9_10.finding: the CHANNEL is openable and it is not the wall.
nfc_supply_u9_10.reading: U9.9's escape BARREL is 0.60 mm and it is what pinches U9.10's channel to 0.350 mm at 0.25 mm out.  Shrink it to 0.50/0.25 -- a geometry that meets every ordinary floor for a Default net and needs no licence at all -- and the channel admits 0.400 mm exactly; shrink it to 0.35/0.20 and it admits 0.6379 mm.  NEITHER closes the land: at the land ROW the ST25R3916's 0.5 mm pitch admits 0.300 mm against P3V3's 0.400 mm floor, and a gated run at both barrels returns the SAME refusal with the SAME counts.  U9.10 remains what D-672 called it -- a 0.100 mm deficit against a vendor land pattern, whose only remaining lever is a published per-net design current for /NFC_SUPPLY, which this board has carried as an OPEN DATA ITEM since D-655 and which is NOT invented here.

promoted.electrical: open-drain wake interrupt, U2.1/U3.1 -> U1.23.  0.200 mm x 104.455 mm plus 16 barrels is about 285 mOhm and about 25 pF; with the strap's pull-up that is a sub-microsecond edge on a signal whose only timing requirement is that the MCU sees it.
